item.title: Brisbane to host global LNG2029 Conference and Exhibition
item.description: Brisbane has been chosen as the 2029 host city for the world’s largest LNG event, bringing thousands of participants from over 80 countries to the Brisbane Convention and Exhibition Centre for LNG2029.

item.title: IEEFA launches LNG export tracker focused on North America
item.description: The newly-launched North American LNG Export Tracker from the Institute for Energy Economics and Financial Analysis visually tells the story of the LNG boom across the continent, export destinations, and the impact on consumers.

item.title: PTT welcomes inaugural LNG cargo from US
item.description: PTT and Cheniere have celebrated the first LNG cargo delivered from the US to Thailand.

item.title: Galveston LNG Bunker Port announces partnership with TOTE Services
item.description: Through their strategic partnership, TOTE Services and the Galveston LNG Bunker Port project aims to deploy a fleet of dedicated Jones Act LNG bunker vessels for the delivery of LNG to customers.

item.title: Mozambique LNG announces full restart of onshore and offshore activities in Mozambique
item.description: TotalEnergies and the Republic of Mozambique have announced the full restart of Mozambique LNG project activities.

item.title: GTT receives LNG carrier order from Hanwha Ocean
item.description: GTT has received an order from Hanwha Ocean for the tank design of two new LNG carriers.

item.title: Axpo LNG bunkering vessel starts operations
item.description: Axpo’s new LNG bunkering vessel is ready to commence operations at the Port of Genoa.

item.title: Open season launches for Zeeland Energy Terminal
item.description: VTTI and Höegh Evi have launched the open season for the Zeeland Energy Terminal.

item.title: OceanScore reaches US$5 million in annual recurring revenue
item.description: OceanScore has reached US$5 million in annual recurring revenue as demand for commercial emissions compliance accelerates.

item.title: TECNIMONT (MAIRE) and Baker Hughes to collaborate on LNG initiatives globally
item.description: TECNIMONT and Baker Hughes have signed a memorandum of understanding to collaborate on prospective modularised, scalable LNG projects.
